content:
We got list of templates. Need one that matches our target molecule. The list includes reaction_id etc. We need to find which template is applicable to our molecule. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching for each template_id. The result includes template_hash but we need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The returned dicts have reaction_id and template_hash. Probably template_id is reaction_id? The description says template_id is integer used to search database not the hash. Likely reaction_id is the template identifier. We'll test matching.

Pick first template reaction_id 401931. Use check.
